story-context.acceptanceCriteria:
1. (AC6.1-01) Account Form Fields: Account form captures account name, bank name, account number (required, unique per company), branch (optional), type (CASH/BANK), opening balance (default 0), GL account code (required, must be leaf account). All required fields validated on save.
2. (AC6.1-02) Account Number Uniqueness: Account number uniqueness enforced at DB constraint and API validation; duplicate returns 409 Conflict with conflicting account details in error response.
3. (AC6.1-03) Inactivation Workflow: Inactivation removes account from pickers but preserves history; inactivation blocked if unposted transactions reference account; error shows blocking transaction count and examples.
4. (AC6.1-04) Delete Protection: Delete blocked if account referenced in any posted voucher/reconciliation; error shows reference count and example transactions with links.
5. (AC6.1-05) Account List Features: Account list supports filter by type (CASH/BANK) and status (active/inactive), search by name/number/bank, sort by balance/last activity; export to CSV/Excel with applied filters in header.
6. (AC6.1-06) Account Picker Enhancement: Account picker displays only active accounts with tooltip showing current balance, last TX date, last reconciled statement date.
7. (AC6.1-07) RBAC Enforcement: Only Admin/Chief Accountant can create/inactivate; Accountant can view and select; all permissions enforced server-side with 403 Forbidden on violation.
8. (AC6.1-08) Audit Logging: Every create/edit/inactivate logged to audit trail with who/when/old/new/IP; blocked attempts logged with reason and message code.
9. (AC6.1-09) Import Functionality: Import accounts via CSV with template validation; atomic batch (all or nothing); duplicates reported with line numbers in error response.
10. (AC6.1-10) Opening Balance Lock: Opening balance locked (uneditable) after first period closes; edit requires admin override with reason, and override action audit-logged.

doc.title: Epic Technical Specification: Cash & Bank Management
doc.snippet: Epic 6 extends existing BankAccount entity (Epic 2) with 4 new fields: glAccountCode (FK to ChartOfAccounts), openingBalanceLocked (Boolean), lastReconciledDate (LocalDate), lastReconciledBalance (BigDecimal). Uses existing ar_payments and ap_payments tables for cash receipts/payments.

doc.title: Epic 6: Cash & Bank Management
doc.snippet: Account form captures account number (unique per company), bank name, type (CASH/BANK), opening balance, GL account. Inactivation preserves history. RBAC: only admin/chief may create/inactivate. Import via CSV with atomic batch.

doc.title: Data Architecture
doc.snippet: Row-level filtering via company_id on all tables. bank_accounts table exists with id, account_number, bank_name, type (CASH/BANK), opening_balance, active status. Chart of Accounts has hierarchical structure (3 levels) with postable leaf accounts.

doc.title: Security Architecture
doc.snippet: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC): Admin, Accountant, Chief Accountant, CFO. Spring Security method-level security via @PreAuthorize annotations. API-level permission checks with company-level data isolation.

Needs enhancements: update() should check openingBalanceLocked; deactivate() should check unposted transactions; delete() should check posted references; getBalanceTooltip() needs actual balance calculation.

story-context.constraints:
1. Entity Extension Pattern: Extend existing BankAccount entity (Epic 2) rather than creating new table. Use Flyway migration to add 4 columns: gl_account_code, opening_balance_locked, last_reconciled_date, last_reconciled_balance.
2. Multi-Tenancy: All queries must filter by company_id. Use CompanyContext.getCompanyId() for automatic filtering. Repository methods must include company_id in WHERE clauses.
3. RBAC Enforcement: Use @PreAuthorize("hasAnyRole('ADMIN', 'CHIEF_ACCOUNTANT')") for create/inactivate endpoints. Accountants can view/select only. Server-side enforcement mandatory - 403 Forbidden on violation.
4. Audit Logging: Every mutation (create/update/delete/activate/deactivate) must call AuditService with old/new values. Blocked attempts (delete protection, inactivation blocked) must also be logged with reason.
5. GL Account Validation: glAccountCode must exist in chart_of_accounts table, be a leaf account (no children), and belong to valid cash/bank categories (1111, 1112 for CASH; 1121, 1122 for BANK). Query ChartOfAccountsRepository for validation.
6. Opening Balance Lock: After first accounting period closes, set openingBalanceLocked = true. Edits require admin override with mandatory reason field. Override logged to audit with HIGH priority.
7. Delete Protection: Hard delete blocked if account referenced in any posted voucher/reconciliation. Until voucher/reconciliation integration complete, enforce strict policy: block all deletes, require deactivation (current implementation at BankAccountServiceImpl.java:268-279).
8. Inactivation Guard: Block inactivation if account referenced in unposted transactions. Query voucher_lines/journal_entries for unposted status. Return error with transaction count and examples (first 5 transactions).
9. Account Number Uniqueness: Enforce at DB level with UNIQUE constraint (company_id, account_number) and API level with existsByCompanyIdAndAccountNumber query. Return 409 Conflict with conflicting account details on duplicate.
10. Import Atomicity: CSV import must be atomic (all or nothing). Use @Transactional with rollback on any error. Collect all validation errors with line numbers before rollback. Return ImportResultDTO with successCount, errorCount, errors array.
11. Balance Calculation: Current balance = opening_balance + SUM(credits) - SUM(debits) from voucher_lines where account_code = bank_account.gl_account_code. Cache in Redis for optimization (optional). For MVP, use opening_balance as placeholder until voucher integration.
12. Existing Patterns: Follow existing repository patterns (company-scoped queries), service patterns (audit logging), controller patterns (@PreAuthorize, ResponseEntity), and import patterns (BankAccountImportHandler template validation).

api.name: GET /api/v1/bank-accounts
api.signature: Page<BankAccountDTO> findAll(Pageable pageable, String type, Boolean status, String search)
api.description: List accounts with pagination, filters (type: CASH|BANK, status: active|inactive), search (account number or bank name with Vietnamese unaccent), sort (balance, lastActivity). Returns page with content array, totalElements, totalPages.

api.name: POST /api/v1/bank-accounts
api.description: Create new account. Validates: accountNumber unique per company, glAccountCode is leaf account. RBAC: Admin/Chief Accountant only. Returns created account with status 201.

api.name: PUT /api/v1/bank-accounts/:id
api.description: Update account. Validates: openingBalance editable only if openingBalanceLocked=false (unless admin override with reason). Captures old/new values for audit. Returns updated account.

api.name: PATCH /api/v1/bank-accounts/:id/deactivate
api.description: Deactivate account (set active=false). Validates: no unposted transactions reference account. Returns 409 Conflict if blocked with transaction count/examples. RBAC: Admin/Chief Accountant.

api.name: GET /api/v1/bank-accounts/:id/balance-tooltip
api.description: Get balance data for picker tooltip. Returns: currentBalance, lastTxDate, lastReconciledDate. For MVP, returns opening balance as placeholder until voucher integration.

api.name: GET /api/v1/bank-accounts/export
api.signature: ResponseEntity<byte[]> export(String format, String type, Boolean status, String search)
api.description: Export accounts to CSV/Excel. Includes applied filters in header. Format: CSV (simple) or EXCEL (formatted with company branding per ARStatementExportServiceImpl pattern). Returns binary file with Content-Disposition header.

api.name: POST /api/v1/bank-accounts/import
api.description: Import accounts from CSV. Validates template headers, performs atomic batch insert. Returns successCount, errorCount, errors array with line numbers. Uses existing BankAccountImportHandler.

interface.name: BankAccountRepository.existsByCompanyIdAndAccountNumber
interface.signature: boolean existsByCompanyIdAndAccountNumber(Long companyId, String accountNumber, Long excludeId)
interface.description: Check account number uniqueness per company. excludeId parameter allows skipping current account ID during updates. Uses @Query with COUNT for efficiency.

interface.name: ChartOfAccountsRepository.findByCompanyIdAndAccountCode
interface.description: Validate GL account code exists and is leaf account. Check parentId is null or has no children. Validate account type matches bank account type (1111/1112 for CASH, 1121/1122 for BANK).
